subject: Unable to access supplier portal after invite — Greymark proxy rewrite
content:
From: Jae Kim <j.kim@greymark.io>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: support@greymark.io
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood supplier invite — cannot complete setup

Hi Stephanie / Redwood team,

We received the supplier portal invite this morning but when I click the activation link I get a 403 / Access Denied page. I work from inside Greymark's corporate network (we use an outbound proxy that rewrites some headers). I've attached a screenshot (screenshot_403_access_denied.png) and the raw SMTP/headers (invite_smtp_header.txt).

We tried in an incognito window and on my phone (cell data) and the same result occurs when on our office network only.

Can you confirm whether the invite link has any additional validation (IP binding, referrer checks, or custom header validation)? We're blocked from onboarding our vendor account and need this cleared to process POs for Redwood.

Thanks,
Jae Kim
Procurement Ops — Greymark Solutions
j.kim@greymark.io

---
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jae Kim <j.kim@greymark.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood supplier invite — cannot complete setup

Hi Jae — thanks for the quick report and for attaching the headers/screenshots.

Short answer: the invite link itself is a one-time tokenized URL but we do not normally bind invites to client IP. That said, some corporate proxies that rewrite or strip Host/Origin/Referer headers can trigger our gateway WAF rules and return 403.

Next steps I recommend so we can unblock you ASAP: 
- Ben from our onboarding team will review the headers you attached and try a resend with a minimized redirect (avoids our WAF rule).
- If that fails, we'll issue a short-lived magic link (expires in 30 minutes) that bypasses some checks for initial setup.
- As a workaround you can temporarily join the invite flow from a non-proxied network (mobile tether or home network).

I'll loop Ben in for the technical follow-up. Apologies for the friction — we'll get this fixed.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales (Onboarding) — Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

---
From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, Jae Kim <j.kim@greymark.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 10:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood supplier invite — cannot complete setup

Hi Jae — Ben here from Onboarding. I pulled the header file you attached. A couple of observations: 

1) I see X-Forwarded-Host: office.greymark.io and a custom header X-GM-Proxy-ID that looks like a per-request rewrite. That combination can trip our edge WAF when the Host doesn't match the downstream TLS SNI in our routing layer.

2) The 403 in the screenshot shows our edge message "Request blocked: suspicious header rewrite" — that confirms the header rewrite hypothesis.

Planned actions: 
- I'll resend the invite from a different edge pool that accepts forwarded host headers (resend-id: RINV-20261003-BC).
- I'll also generate a one-time magic link (MAGIC-RINV-9876) valid for 30 minutes and include it below. Use that link from your corporate network and let us know if it succeeds.
- If it still fails, please ask your network team to allowlist outbound traffic to our edge IP range and to preserve the Host header (we can provide IPs).

Temporary magic link (do not share broadly): https://portal.redwood.com/invite/one-time/MAGIC-RINV-9876

Attachments included on our side: none. We'll follow up if we need additional logs.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Customer Onboarding Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

---
From: Jae Kim <j.kim@greymark.io>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: support@greymark.io
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood supplier invite — cannot complete setup

Thanks Ben / Stephanie — the magic link worked from inside our corporate network (loaded the "Complete your supplier profile" page and allowed me to set the account). We completed the required fields and uploaded our W-9.

I've notified our IT team to preserve the Host header for future invites. They also captured a short proxy rule that was rewriting host for certain SaaS domains; they've added your edge IPs to the allowlist as a precaution.

Summary / next steps: 
- Issue resolved with one-time magic link.
- Greymark IT is allowlisting Redwood edge IPs and will stop the host rewrite for invite flows.
- Please mark the original invite token RINV-20261003-BC as completed and close the ticket.

Thanks for the rapid turnaround.

Best,
Jae Kim
Procurement Ops — Greymark Solutions

----
Technical notes / internal follow-up (internal only):
- Mark ticket HS-00098765 as "onboarded - proxy rewrite remediated" and record edge pool used.
- Consider adding a short-lived magic link path to the standard invite retry flow for customers behind header-rewriting proxies (RFC/POC).
